narr: Evening rain and storms caused flash flooding over the southern part of the Hermits Peak Calf Canyon burn scar at San Ignacio.
ev: NWS Flood survey found evidence of multiple mud/debris flow overs County Road A3A. There was also evidence of water over a bridge and culvert. Debris left behind by the waters was stuck against guard rails.
